name: Merck & Co
why: Keytruda (pembrolizumab) — world's #1 antibody franchise by revenue.

name: AbbVie
why: Humira (adalimumab), Skyrizi, Rinvoq — historically dominant immunology antibody portfolio.

name: Bristol Myers Squibb
why: Opdivo (nivolumab), Yervoy (ipilimumab) — checkpoint inhibitor pioneer.

name: Roche
why: Genentech antibodies, oncology market leader, broad biologics franchise.

name: Novartis
why: Cosentyx (secukinumab), Kesimpta — biologics across immunology and neurology.

name: Sanofi
why: Dupixent (dupilumab) co-developed with Regeneron — fastest-growing immunology antibody.

name: Eli Lilly
why: Donanemab (Alzheimer's), mirikizumab (UC), broad antibody pipeline.

name: AstraZeneca
why: Imfinzi (durvalumab), Enhertu ADC — oncology biologics leader.

name: Pfizer
why: Sasanlimab, broad ADC pipeline post-Seagen acquisition.

name: GSK
why: Blenrep (belantamab), Jemperli — oncology antibody bets.

name: Johnson & Johnson
why: Stelara, Tremfya, Darzalex — multiple billion-dollar antibody franchises.

name: Takeda
why: Vonoritamab pipeline, biologics bets in rare disease.

name: Regeneron
why: Dupixent (with Sanofi), Eylea — pure antibody-discovery powerhouse.

name: Genmab
why: DuoBody bispecifics platform, Darzalex co-developed with J&J.

name: Alector
why: Neuro antibodies (AL001 against FTD), GSK partnership.

name: Adaptive Biotechnologies
why: Immune repertoire sequencing, clonotype tracking — directly relevant to discovery infrastructure.

name: Absci
why: Generative AI for de novo antibody design — direct peer to ENPICOM in the AI tooling layer.

name: Recursion Pharmaceuticals
why: AI-driven drug discovery, image-based phenotyping — broader than antibodies but adjacent.

name: Schrödinger
why: Computational drug design, physics-based + ML — used widely by big pharma.

name: Prothena
why: Neurological / amyloid antibodies, partnered with Roche on prasinezumab.

name: MacroGenics
why: DART and TRIDENT bispecific platforms.

name: Vir Biotechnology
why: Infectious-disease antibodies (sotrovimab), broad antiviral platform.

name: Compugen
why: Computational checkpoint discovery, partnerships with BMS and AstraZeneca.

name: ALX Oncology
why: CD47 checkpoint inhibitor evorpacept.

name: 10x Genomics
why: Single-cell sequencing — backbone of many antibody-discovery workflows.

name: Twist Bioscience
why: Synthetic DNA for antibody libraries, partnership with biopharma.

name: Bruker
why: SPR (surface plasmon resonance), mass spec — affinity and characterization.

name: Illumina
why: Sequencing infrastructure for repertoire and discovery work.

name: Quanterix
why: Ultra-sensitive Simoa immunoassay — biomarker quantification at low abundance.

name: Lonza
why: Largest contract biologics manufacturer in Europe.

name: Samsung Biologics
why: World's largest biologics CDMO by capacity.

name: WuXi Biologics
why: Major Asia-Pacific biologics CDMO, geopolitical exposure (BIOSECURE Act).

name: Fujifilm Diosynth
why: Biologics CDMO arm of Fujifilm — capacity expansions in US/UK/Denmark.
